regime_context: The detector shows a broad eligible rotation (13/16) with Big Banks leading, Base Metals & Copper challenging narrowly, and Gold Miners showing the strongest trend/durability texture. The absolute-trend gate has helped control drawdown in this market's history, but momentum rank and rotation timing carry no validated alpha, and the 24-call direction accuracy is 0.50, so directional leans are capped at low conviction.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the prevailing narrative with full breadth and eligibility. The absolute-trend gate is the validated staying-power leg, so a conditional overweight is reasonable while crowding (z=1.01) counsels sizing down rather than fading.
evidence: Rotation leader ca_banks; rank 1, eligible true
theses.dissent: Momentum rank is a focus lens with near-zero rank-IC, and a crowded bank theme can reverse hard on credit or macro stress.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by 5 percentage points or more over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the narrow challenger, fully eligible, uncrowded, and broad. With the trend gate validated for drawdown control, a conditional overweight is defensible only if it holds eligible status.
theses.dissent: Copper/base metals are highly macro-sensitive and the narrow margin to banks means this is not a confirmed handoff; momentum rank is not alpha.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO falls 8% or more over the next 20 trading days while the S&P/TSX Composite is flat or positive.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners show the strongest trend/durability texture (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar=0.82) and are uncrowded. The trend gate's drawdown control is the only validated leg, so a conditional stay is justified if the trend persists.
theses.dissent: Gold miners can gap on real yields, USD, or idiosyncratic miner risk; trend strength is coincident, not a return forecast.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by 8 percentage points or more over the next 30 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
